verses.1: By the holy ark. And He sanctified every ark of the law, and He sealed it in the covenant of God, which He established with them as a covenant of peace. And they shall be His people, at the time when He gathers His servants, the saints, because their covenant is everlasting. And also the arks and the altars in the covenant of God, that they may be blessed in that they worship the Most High, for the sake of God. And also in this covenant, all the saints who are perfect, and they shall be blessed: the priests, and the kings, and the prophets, in the covenant of the ark and in its glory.
